name: Alternative Classes with Different Interfaces
description: Two classes that perform identical functions but have different method names, resulting in unnecessary duplication and complexity.

refactoringTechniques.name: Extract Interface
refactoringTechniques.description: Create a common interface that both classes can implement to standardize method signatures.

refactoringTechniques.name: Rename Methods
refactoringTechniques.description: Rename methods in one class to match the other class's naming convention.

refactoringTechniques.name: Move Method
refactoringTechniques.description: Move unique functionality from one class to the other to consolidate similar functionality.

refactoringTechniques.name: Merge Classes
refactoringTechniques.description: If the classes are truly identical in purpose, merge them into a single class.
